title: guard-main refuses a script that only names the checks dir
what: guard-main refuses only commands that write into .relay/checks, not a read-only command whose text merely contains that path (a heredoc script that reads the queue and prints a string naming the folder).
why: 25 Oct, live: a python3 heredoc in the main checkout that only read .relay/queue/*.json and printed a string containing ".relay/checks writes" was refused ("files in .relay/checks are written only by relay"). A false refusal costs a retry each time and teaches agents to rephrase around the guard. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: guard-main.sh fed a Bash tool input whose command is a python3 heredoc that prints the text ".relay/checks writes" and writes no file: refused.
pass_cases: That input is allowed; `echo x > .relay/checks/a.json`, `cp f .relay/checks/` and a python heredoc that opens a file there for writing stay refused.
where: plugins/core/hooks/guard-main.sh (the rule on writes to the checks folder)
